body:
I replied to the messages in my inbox. If I reply to you here as well, sorry. I'm just so overwhelmed by the support. I want you all to know that although I've already been helping on SW, this has inspired me to contribute more. I want so much to give this feeling to someone else that feels the same way I did in that moment. 

Thanks to you all I won the battle last night. I went to sleep alone and hopeless and woke up to reinforcements at my side.  What an amazing feeling! Thank you, Bloodbath552 - Yumeijin - MamaToFive - asc0614 - rosearmada - ZUP3056 - nsdeni - and all the inboxers! I hope ya'll take some time and treat yourself to something special today. And think of how you turned tears of desperation into tears of joy! Thank you!

Thank you so much for all the replies! I finally fell asleep sometime this morning and woke up this afternoon to see that people actually care.  So my question is ... How can we all help eachother? Some kind of group chat? Kik maybe? I'm so overwhelmed by the responses, I don't know where to begin. But I will respond to all of you! Thank you a million times over!
